reason: A sidebar and bottom-panel workspace framework is the primary purpose, with integrated file tools, browser, terminal, Git, task, chat, and third-party tab/viewer extension APIs documented in the README.

summaries.zh: 提供可扩展的侧边栏与底部面板工作台，集成文件管理编辑、终端、浏览器、Git、任务和侧边对话等功能。
summaries.en: An extensible sidebar and bottom-panel workspace that integrates file management and editing, a terminal, browser, Git, tasks, and side conversations.

capabilities: Provides right-sidebar and bottom-panel workspaces with tabs, split panes, and session-persisted layouts.
Provides file browsing, uploading, editing, and previews for images, Markdown, HTML, and PDF files.
Provides an embedded browser using sandboxed iframes with configurable external-link handling.
Provides a real shell through xterm.js and node-pty, including reconnect replay and optional model-invoked terminal tools.
Provides Git staging, commits, reverts, history, and diff views.
Provides background task and sub-agent status views, plus side conversation threads.
Exposes APIs for third-party plugins to register sidebar tabs and file viewers.
